thag15.1:1.1: Cuddasanipāto niṭṭhito. SOḶASANIPĀTO. Esa bhiyyo pasīdāmi sutvā dhammaṃ mahārasaṃ; virāgo desito dhammo anupādāya sabbaso. || ||
thag15.1:2.1: bahūni loke citrāni asmiṃ puthuvimaṇḍale mathenti maññesaṃkappaṃ subhaṃ rāgūpasaṃhitaṃ. || ||
thag15.1:3.1: rajam upātaṃ vātena yathā megho pasāmaye, evaṃ sammanti saṃkappā yadā paññāya passati. || ||
thag15.1:4.1: sabbe saṃkhārā aniccā 'ti yadā paññāya passati, atha nibbindatī dukkhe: esa maggo visuddhiyā. || ||
thag15.1:6.1: sabbe dhammā anattā 'ti yadā paññāya passati, atha nibbindatī dukkhe: esa maggo visuddhiyā. || ||
thag15.1:7.1: buddhānubuddho yo thero Koṇḍañño tibbanikkhamo pahīnajātimaraṇo brahmacariyassa kevalī. || ||
thag15.1:8.1: oghāpāso daḷho khīlo, pabbato duppadāliyo: chetvā khīlañ ca pāsañ ca selaṃ chetvāna dubbhidaṃ tiṇṇo pāraṃgato jhāyī mutto so Mārabandhanā. || ||
thag15.1:9.1: uddhato capalo bhikkhu mitte āgamma pāpake saṃsīdati mahoghasmiṃ ummiyā paṭikujjito. || ||
thag15.1:10.1: anuddhato acapalo nipako saṃvutindriyo kalyāṇamitto medhāvī dukkhass' antakaro siyā.
thag15.1:16.1: yassa c' atthāya pabbajito agārasmā anagāriyaṃ, so me attho anuppatto, kiṃ me sandavihārenā 'ti. || || Aññākoṇḍañño thero.
